propositions.canonicalProposition: The model inventory lists the candidate as accountable model owner for the card-not-present fraud model from 2022 to 2024.
propositions.rationale: The recruiter's verification records the model risk team's written confirmation of the inventory entry.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate approved two decline-threshold changes in 2023 after weekly reviews with the fraud operations manager, recorded in the model change log.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the approvals and the change-log entry shows the candidate's approval.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate presented the half-yearly performance review of the card-not-present model to the model risk committee.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the review and its contents.

expectedGap: The candidate reviewed latency reports; the real-time scoring service was built and run by the platform team.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the verified model ownership, the recorded threshold approvals and the committee reviews; do not describe the candidate as having built or operated the scoring service.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask what part the candidate played in the real-time scoring service beyond reviewing latency reports.
